strategy.note: basis: Fig. 7.5 'Flows for “packing, clay products”', per 1 kg of clay product packed (the module's reference flow, 1.00E+00 kg); allocation: none stated. The module is derived from 'packing, lime products' by scaling the flows with the ratio of bulk densities (about 800 kg/m3 for average lime product, 1'600 kg/m3 for clay products).. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: No direct emissions other than waste heat are given; no dust from the packing operation.
The paper/bag material itself is not inventoried - only pallets and plastic foil appear.
Fig. 7.5's mean values are extrapolated from the lime-product module, so every figure inherits that module's data rather than measurements on clay products.
